title: Do these 5 every day this week before the house wakes up
caption: Quiet morning workout before the house wakes up: Glute Bridge, Air Squat, Knee Plank, Wall Slide, Shoulder Blade Squeeze. Two rounds on the floor at 6am, ten minutes, and nothing that makes a sound. Save this for tomorrow morning.

overlays.text: Do these 5 every day this week, before the house wakes up.

scenes.footer: Hinge. You never leave the floor.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Squat. Slow and silent, no jumping.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width, sit down slowly, stand back up tall.

scenes.footer: Core. Held still, so nothing creaks.

overlays.text: Knee Plank. 25 seconds. Forearms down, knees down, hold one straight line.
Wall Slide. 10 reps. Back on the wall, slide your arms up and down slowly.
Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Pull your shoulder blades together, then let go.

scenes.footer: No push this week. At 6am it is the loud one. Back next week.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the five. Ten minutes, and nothing that makes a sound.
Which one will you start with?
